d.ko: After making a big mistake while trying to craft a potion at the alchemy university, the apprentice alchemist Mira finds that she has exposed herself to an elixir that made fundamental changes to her body. Now she must go in search of the ingredients in order to craft the antidote.
d.en: After making a big mistake while trying to craft a potion at the alchemy university, the apprentice alchemist Mira finds that she has exposed herself to an elixir that made fundamental changes to her body. Now she must go in search of the ingredients in order to craft the antidote.
d.zh: 见习炼金师米拉在炼金学院尝试合成药剂时犯了大错，之后她发现自己的身体产生了奇妙的变化。为了制作解毒剂，米拉只好踏上了四处收集素材的旅途…...
